description: This file is a PHP script that handles AJAX requests to set or retrieve user dashboard information like battery status, internet connectivity, WiFi status, MoCA, and firewall level. It includes session validation, gathers device status information via getStr calls, processes this data, and outputs a JSON configuration with status tips for use in a web UI.

methods.name: get_tips
methods.description: Generates user-facing tooltip messages based on device status types and their current states.
